spellbook.finance/limitations: A preview does not mutate saved settings or membership. Backend policy requires an authorized workspace owner, eligible Seller entitlement and agent_marketplace_publish for the write path.
The feature flag defaults off and is checked by the backend. A cap reduction reports exits; this tool has no cap override.
Apply must carry the exact preview revision, previewId and change. A stale apply makes no change; re-read and ask the owner to approve a fresh preview.
Turning discovery off clears settings and reports restoration as pending when applicable. It does not reverse sends already admitted to a marketplace lane.
An observed ask is sampled evidence. It is not a scheduled floor, final calculated ask, continuous exposure claim or proof of demand.

description: Preview or apply an owner-requested below-floor discovery settings, printing membership, or off change. The default dry run returns exact entering, exiting and rejected rows plus the settings-only restoration effect. Call dryRun true first. If the owner asked only for a preview, stop there. If the owner explicitly authorized saving and the preview matches the requested change, apply with dryRun false and the same opaque expectedRevisionToken, previewId and change without asking for approval again. If apply returns stale, read spellbook_below_floor_discovery_get and request a new preview; never apply a refreshed selection automatically. Read the GET tool after a successful apply to confirm saved state and restoration status.

change.description: Exact configuration, membership or off change to preview. Never substitute an unreviewed change during apply.

addPrintings.description: Exact printing identities to add; every identity is checked against the configured lane and admission guards.

items.description: A printing identity to add to the selected configured lane.

finish.description: Exact supported finish for the game.

printingId.description: Exact catalog printing identifier; case is significant.

kind.description: Save discovery settings and optional exact printing membership changes.

removePrintings.description: Exact printing identities to remove. The preview reports affected members and reasons.

items.description: A printing identity to remove from the selected configured lane.

finish.description: Exact supported finish for the game.

printingId.description: Exact catalog printing identifier; case is significant.

settings.description: Complete saved settings for this discovery configuration.

idleDaysBeforeEntry.description: Idle days required before an eligible printing can enter discovery.

lanes.description: Enabled discovery lanes. An empty array disables all lanes while keeping the configuration saved.

items.description: One enabled game and channel lane with its approved minimum.

channel.description: Marketplace channel supported for the selected game.

game.description: Game for this exact discovery lane.

lowestAskUsd.description: Owner-approved lowest ask in USD, in cent precision.

maxPrintings.description: Maximum unique printings in the configured discovery cap.

kind.description: Remove saved settings and stop discovery through the explicit preview and apply flow.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

dryRun.description: True to create a non-mutating preview. False applies only the exact previously approved preview.

expectedRevisionToken.description: The opaque revisionToken from the latest GET response or the preview's baseRevisionToken. Preserve the exact string.

previewId.description: The exact previewId returned by the preview being approved. Required when dryRun is false.

workspaceId.description: The seller workspace to configure. Required.
